{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A wool-blend cardigan in charcoal gray (#2F3542), relaxed fit with ribbed cuffs and hem, knee-length for layering warmth over trousers.
Wide-leg wool-twill trousers in deep forest green (#1B3626), mid-rise waist, full length reaching the ankle with a subtle crease for structure.
Soft knit turtleneck in cream white (#F5F5DC), slim silhouette, hip-length to provide thermal insulation without bulk.
Chunky leather Chelsea boots in black oxblood (#4A0404), platform sole for snow traction, ankle height keeping cold out while walking to work.
A thin merino wool scarf in heathered slate (#5D6E7C), rectangular drape style with fringed edges for texture contrast against the solid garments.

This outfit works because the three-layering system of a warm turtleneck, insulating cardigan, and sturdy trousers ensures comfort during the -15°C winter commute without restricting movement. The dark forest green trousers and charcoal outer layer provide a professional yet grounded aesthetic suitable for a work setting in snowy conditions. Chunky Chelsea boots offer essential grip on salted roads while the thick knit fabrics create a necessary barrier against biting wind and freezing precipitation."}
